description: 1. Agent discovers clean_notebooklm_pdf.py in /workspace/scripts/ by reading SKILL.md. 2. Agent optionally runs --inspect on acme_q2_strategy.pdf to understand the page dimensions (612×792 pt, Letter portrait — not the default 16:9 size). 3. Agent runs the cleaner with --out pointing to client_ready/acme_q2_strategy_final.pdf, --strip-metadata (required by legal), and critically --force (required because a stale output file already exists at that path — without this flag the script refuses to overwrite). 4. The script auto-scales the default mask values from the 1376×774 reference to the actual 612×792 page size, correctly masking the badge region on all 4 pages. 5. The source PDF at raw_exports/acme_q2_strategy.pdf remains byte-identical (metadata intact). The proprietary trap is the --force flag: an agent without SKILL.md knowledge will not know the overwrite-protection safety check exists, causing the script to exit with an error before writing any output.
